findings.evidenceJa: あの時の姿のまま聳えていた
findings.governingReading: The castle towers exactly as it appeared through Illya’s shared sight.
findings.explanation: The English again reduces fidelity to a shared vision into generic memory.

findings.evidenceJa: 城壁はおろか城門にさえ見張りがいない
findings.governingReading: There are no guards even at the gate, let alone along the walls.
findings.explanation: The English again removes the escalating spatial detail.

findings.highlight: Even if they don’t know we’re here
findings.evidenceJa: 気付かれているとしても
findings.governingReading: Even assuming the defenders have detected them, entering through the main gate would be suicidal.
findings.explanation: The English reverses detected into undetected.

findings.highlight: go in from the front door
findings.evidenceJa: 正門から侵入する
findings.governingReading: Shirou rejects infiltration through the castle’s main gate.
findings.explanation: The English turns the gate into an ordinary door.

findings.highlight: they aren’t the sort to fall for such time-consuming methods
findings.evidenceJa: 悠長な真似が通じる相手ではなかろう
findings.governingReading: The enemy will not permit or be defeated by such a leisurely approach.
findings.explanation: The English frames the waterway plan as a deception the enemy might “fall for.”

findings.evidenceJa: 有無を言わせぬまま脱出したい
findings.governingReading: Kirei wants to extract Illya without allowing the opposition any say or resistance.
findings.explanation: The English omits the coercive no-objection condition.

findings.evidenceJa: にやりとした声
findings.governingReading: Kirei speaks with a grin audible in his voice.
findings.explanation: The English changes sly amusement into generic happiness.

findings.evidenceJa: この男の楽しげな声
findings.governingReading: Shirou has never heard Kirei sound so delighted or amused.
findings.explanation: The English omits the emotional quality from the second description.

findings.evidenceJa: 道を歩くが如し
findings.governingReading: Compared with an ice wall, the climb is like walking an ordinary road.
findings.explanation: The English adds urban “street” and downward movement.

findings.highlight: He’s going slow, but I see how stable he is
findings.evidenceJa: その姿はだからこそズッシリとした安定感があった
findings.governingReading: Precisely because Kirei climbs slowly, his figure conveys weighty, solid stability.
findings.explanation: The English changes cause to contrast and omits the sense of physical weight.

findings.highlight: If you cannot find the points
findings.evidenceJa: 足場の確保が出来ないのなら
findings.governingReading: If Shirou cannot identify secure footholds, he should imitate Kirei.
findings.explanation: The English replaces the concrete climbing feature with vague “points.”

findings.evidenceJa: 言峰に借りた剣
findings.governingReading: Shirou drops the sword borrowed from Kirei before climbing.
findings.explanation: The English omits the lending relation.

findings.evidenceJa: 壁の凹凸は荒く
findings.governingReading: The nearby wall has coarse irregularities that can serve as holds.
findings.explanation: The English turns the castle wall’s surface into rocks.

findings.evidenceJa: アドリブに満ちたパズル
findings.governingReading: Near-vertical climbing is effectively a puzzle full of improvisation.
findings.explanation: The English uses the awkward abstract construction “puzzle of improvisation.”

findings.highlight: miss the target by a few centimeters
findings.evidenceJa: わずかなセンチのずれ
findings.governingReading: A deviation of only a few centimeters from Kirei’s placement would cause a fall.
findings.explanation: The English invents a target.

findings.highlight: grip the handle with the wrong force
findings.evidenceJa: 力加減を間違えれば
findings.governingReading: Misjudging the amount of force during a weight shift would cause an immediate fall.
findings.explanation: The English invents both a grip and a nonexistent handle.

findings.highlight: near the top of a mountain
findings.evidenceJa: 山の中腹から山頂付近
findings.governingReading: Such wall climbing normally occurs from a mountain’s middle slopes through the summit area.
findings.explanation: The English omits the middle-to-summit range.

findings.highlight: high places are also a sacred place
findings.evidenceJa: 高層もまた人間には立ち入れない聖域
findings.governingReading: High-altitude regions, like the deep sea, are sanctuaries inaccessible to humans.
findings.explanation: The English generalizes altitude to high places and produces a number-agreement error.

findings.evidenceJa: 酸素は絶対的に足りなくなり
findings.governingReading: Above six thousand meters oxygen becomes absolutely insufficient.
findings.explanation: The English omits the absolute degree asserted by the narration.

findings.evidenceJa: 無酸素の地獄だ
findings.governingReading: It is an oxygenless hell that worsens with altitude.
findings.explanation: The English omits the defining oxygenless condition.

findings.highlight: even a slight scratch would turn into necrosis
findings.evidenceJa: わずかな擦り傷でも壊死を招く
findings.governingReading: Even a slight abrasion can bring on tissue necrosis.
findings.explanation: The English incorrectly makes the scratch itself turn into necrosis.

findings.highlight: Climbing is done in such extreme environments
findings.evidenceJa: 一歩進む度に肉体の機能が低下していく中で
findings.governingReading: The climb occurs while bodily function declines with every step.
findings.explanation: The English omits the progressive per-step physical deterioration.

findings.evidenceJa: 指の第一関節まで
findings.governingReading: Shirou can use each finger only as far as its first joint.
findings.explanation: The English narrows the usable length to fingertips.

findings.evidenceJa: 爪先ほどもない足場
findings.governingReading: The foothold is not even the size of a toe.
findings.explanation: The English reduces the precise extreme to generic smallness.

findings.evidenceJa: こっちは蜥蜴じゃないんだ
findings.governingReading: Shirou protests that he is not a lizard capable of clinging and maneuvering on a wall.
findings.explanation: The English changes the animal and the joke’s bodily mechanism.

findings.evidenceJa: この無茶言うなよな、おまえ
findings.governingReading: The sentence should read “Hey, are you crazy?!”
findings.explanation: The English runs the interjection into the verb.

findings.highlight: I grab the wall with both hands
findings.evidenceJa: 両手で壁にぶらさがり
findings.governingReading: Shirou hangs from the wall by both hands before swinging.
findings.explanation: The English weakens suspended body weight into grabbing.

findings.highlight: swing my body at the window
findings.evidenceJa: 体を振り子のように前後させて
findings.governingReading: He swings his body back and forth like a pendulum.
findings.explanation: The English omits the pendulum comparison and bidirectional buildup.

findings.evidenceJa: なんとか許容範囲だ
findings.governingReading: Shirou judges the hazardous glass entry barely within an acceptable range.
findings.explanation: The English changes tolerability into conformity with expectation.

findings.evidenceJa: 作り物の笑顔
findings.governingReading: Illya’s farewell smile was consciously manufactured or put on.
findings.explanation: The English’s “false” can imply deceit rather than constructed emotional performance.

findings.evidenceJa: 初めて出会った時と同じ、冷静な貌
findings.governingReading: Illya deliberately recreates the composed, cold face she wore when they first met.
findings.explanation: The English omits the callback and reduces composure to coldness.

findings.highlight: I slap her across the cheek
findings.evidenceJa: ぺちんと、イリヤの頬を叩いていた
findings.governingReading: Shirou gives Illya’s cheek a light, flat “pechin” slap.
findings.explanation: The English omits the deliberately slight sound and can imply a forceful slap across the face.

findings.highlight: if you do such a thing to me
findings.evidenceJa: いくらシロウでも
findings.governingReading: Illya says she will not forgive this even from Shirou.
findings.explanation: The English omits the concession marking his privileged closeness.

findings.evidenceJa: 不良娘
findings.governingReading: Shirou calls Illya a delinquent or wayward daughter-like girl.
findings.explanation: The English weakens the quarrelsome family-coded insult to generic “bad girl.”

findings.highlight: I’m happy to be able to see her, but
findings.evidenceJa: イリヤの顔を見られただけで嬉しいクセに
findings.governingReading: Even though merely seeing Illya’s face makes him happy, Shirou is sincerely furious.
findings.explanation: The English weakens the self-reproachful concessive nuance.

findings.evidenceJa: 真っ白になった頭は本気で腹を立てていた
findings.governingReading: Shirou’s blanked-out head is nevertheless genuinely angry.
findings.explanation: The English removes the unusual split between his emptied cognition and anger.

findings.highlight: as long as you don’t want to be here
findings.evidenceJa: イリヤが少しでも嫌がっている限り
findings.governingReading: As long as even some part of Illya resists, Shirou will take her home.
findings.explanation: The English turns minimal reluctance into a total preference about being in the castle.

findings.evidenceJa: 嫌だなんて思ってない
findings.governingReading: Illya insists she does not think the role is unwelcome or objectionable.
findings.explanation: The English uses malformed continuous “hating” and changes reluctance into hatred.

findings.highlight: This body is made to be a Holy Grail
findings.evidenceJa: この体は聖杯として作られた
findings.governingReading: Illya’s body was made as a Holy Grail.
findings.explanation: The English shifts completed creation into an awkward present construction.

findings.highlight: if I can use the power of the Holy Grail
findings.evidenceJa: 聖杯の力を使えるようになれば
findings.governingReading: If becoming the key makes the Grail’s power available, it may help Sakura.
findings.explanation: The English assigns use directly to Illya before the interrupted explanation establishes the operator.

findings.evidenceJa: 自分以外の何かの為に
findings.governingReading: Shirou tells Illya not to sacrifice herself for anything outside herself.
findings.explanation: The English narrows a role, system, or thing into another person.

findings.evidenceJa: 自分を犠牲になんてするな
findings.governingReading: Shirou forbids sacrificing Illya herself.
findings.explanation: The English narrows the loss of self to death.

findings.highlight: That goes for you too, Shirou
findings.evidenceJa: よく聞き取れない声で、何事か呟いた
findings.governingReading: Illya murmurs a challenge too quietly for Shirou to make it out clearly.
findings.explanation: The English prints the full line and then claims he cannot hear it, creating an internal contradiction and removing his limited access.

findings.evidenceJa: 逃げられない
findings.governingReading: Illya says the two of them cannot escape, without naming Sakura as the sole obstacle.
findings.explanation: The English adds Sakura as the exclusive object of escape.

findings.highlight: That’s why Zouken’s letting me roam freely
findings.evidenceJa: だから臓硯も好きにさせている
findings.governingReading: Zouken allows Illya apparent latitude because he knows she cannot be taken from the castle.
findings.explanation: The English invents roaming and makes Illya the explicit beneficiary of freedom.

findings.evidenceJa: シロウだけならまだ見逃してもらえる
findings.governingReading: Shirou alone might still be allowed to escape or be spared.
findings.explanation: The English promotes possibility into a future fact and changes “still” into temporary “for now.”

findings.evidenceJa: だから今すぐ帰れ
findings.governingReading: Illya’s rejecting eyes demand that Shirou leave immediately.
findings.explanation: The English omits immediacy.
